scripts.kill: pkill -f 'uvicorn' && pkill -f 'next dev' && echo '✅ All development servers stopped' || echo '✅ No servers running'
scripts.kill:backend: pkill -f 'uvicorn' && echo '✅ Backend server stopped' || echo '✅ Backend not running'
scripts.kill:frontend: pkill -f 'next dev' && echo '✅ Frontend server stopped' || echo '✅ Frontend not running'
scripts.kill:ports: lsof -ti:8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Ports 8000 and 3000 freed' || echo '✅ Ports already free'
scripts.status: ps aux | grep -E '(uvicorn|next dev)' | grep -v grep || echo 'No servers running'
scripts.reset: npm run kill && npm run kill:ports && echo '✅ All servers and ports cleared'
